currentGoalSnapshot.title: Proteinbiosynthese erklären
currentGoalSnapshot.description: Die lernende Person kann Transkription und Translation modellhaft darstellen.
currentGoalSnapshot.descriptionEn: The learner can model transcription and translation.

operativeContextBindings.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den Informationsfluss von einer gegebenen DNA-Sequenz über mRNA zu einem Polypeptid modellhaft darstellen und die Verbindung von Transkription und Translation erklären.
operativeContextBindings.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can model the information flow from a supplied DNA sequence via mRNA to a polypeptide and explain the connection between transcription and translation.

findings.finding: DNA→mRNA→polypeptide is correctly ordered. Visible Zellkern/Zellplasma compartments and mRNA through a pore identify an eukaryotic model. Transcription and translation occupy their corresponding compartments.
Actual pink RNA is one continuous unbranched strand with base symbols along it; no branched RNA or peptide attached to RNA visible.

Actual yellow five-bead peptide extends horizontally from upper ribosomal subunit; clear blue background gap separates every bead from the RNA. Lower-right separate bead icon is a symbolic product legend, not a second attached pathway.

Header and process arrows express a schematic information pathway. No labeled exact DNA sequence, codon table, chemical stoichiometry, or peptide length is claimed. This is a staged process diagram, not a literal single-time geometry of one molecule spanning nucleus and ribosome.

Header DNA→mRNA→Polypeptid, compartment names, main process/ribosome labels and footer remain recognizable. Small supplementary Information wird abgeschrieben is not needed to recover the core scientific relationship; must not become required small-print evidence.

Main labels, RNA path, peptide/RNA separation and compartment distinction clear at680 and native. Friendly clear comic shapes and existing landscape style;1672×941 approximately16:9 PNG fits the requested production format.

requiredAltQualificationDe: Schematischer Informationsweg einer eukaryotischen Zelle: DNA im Zellkern wird in mRNA umgeschrieben; nach dem Export ins Zellplasma dient mRNA am Ribosom als Vorlage für ein Polypeptid. Die gelbe Perlenkette symbolisiert das Polypeptid und bleibt vom RNA-Strang getrennt. Die Darstellung verbindet aufeinanderfolgende Schritte und zeigt keine maßstabsgerechte Momentaufnahme oder konkrete Basen- und Aminosäuresequenz.
requiredAltQualificationEn: Schematic information pathway in a eukaryotic cell: DNA in the nucleus is transcribed into mRNA; after export into the cytoplasm, mRNA serves as the template for a polypeptide at the ribosome. The yellow bead chain symbolizes the polypeptide and remains separate from the RNA strand. The diagram connects successive steps; it is not a to-scale snapshot or a specified nucleotide and amino-acid sequence.
limitations: Orientation visualization, not full protein-biosynthesis assessment or evidence for the supplied-sequence task.
Maturation, polymerase, tRNA and detailedcodon recognition are omitted; no claim that they are absent in real biology.
Required alt/context must retain the eukaryotic staged-model boundary and symbolic product legend.
